    Publication theme

    Source: R/plots-design.R
    cr_theme.Rd

    The single ggplot2 theme every cr_plot_* function applies, so that figures assembled from different functions sit together without re-styling: a classic axis-line frame, a faint major grid, a bold title, a muted subtitle and a bottom legend.

    Usage

    cr_theme(
  base_size = 11,
  base_family = "",
  grid = TRUE,
  legend_position = "bottom"
)

    Arguments

    base_size

    Base font size in points (default 11).

    base_family

    Base font family. Default "" (the device default), which keeps figures reproducible across machines.

    grid

    Draw the faint major grid (default TRUE).

    legend_position

    Passed to ggplot2::theme(). Default "bottom".

    Value

    A ggplot2 theme object, usable with + like any other theme.

    See also

    cr_palette(), cr_scale_group()

    Other plot design: cr_palette(), cr_scale_group(), cr_shapes()

    Examples

    df <- data.frame(g = rep(c("a", "b"), each = 20), y = rnorm(40))
ggplot2::ggplot(df, ggplot2::aes(g, y)) +
  ggplot2::geom_boxplot() +
  cr_theme()
